2027-01-21.title: Saint Agnes, Virgin and Martyr
readings: He always lives to make intercession for them
Here am I, Lord; I come to do your will
Whenever the unclean spirits saw him, they shouted, You are the Son of God!
2027-01-21.alt: Memorial. Thursday of the Second Week in Ordinary Time (Year I). Week of Prayer for Christian Unity (18–25 January). Liturgical colour: red.
2027-01-21.verse: Consequently he is able for all time to save those who approach God through him, since he always lives to make intercession for them.
theo: Hebrews offers one of the most comforting truths in the New Testament: Christ “is able for all time to save those who approach God through him, since he always lives to make intercession for them.” Right now, at the Father's right hand, the risen Jesus is praying for you. Unlike earthly priests who offered sacrifices daily, he offered himself “once for all”, and is “the mediator of a better covenant”.

Mark describes crowds pressing on Jesus from every region, so many that he asks for a boat to be ready. “All who had diseases pressed upon him to touch him.” The unclean spirits fall before him and shout, “You are the Son of God!”, but he silences them; he will be revealed in his own way, on the Cross. Today we honour St Agnes, a Roman girl of about twelve or thirteen who refused to give up her consecration to Christ and was martyred around 304. The weakest in the world's eyes, she was strong because her Lord was interceding for her.
outline: Point 2 · Crowds press to touch him
Our need draws us to him.
A girl who conquered by faith.
“He always lives to make intercession for them.”
live: When anxious today, say: Jesus is praying for me now.

2027-01-21.prayer: Lord Jesus, you live for ever to intercede for us. Draw us to touch you in faith, and through the prayers of St Agnes give us courage and purity to belong wholly to you. Amen.
altar: At every Mass Christ's eternal intercession is made present. We join his prayer to the Father.

quick: Christ always lives to intercede for us.

illus: St Agnes's name sounds like the Latin agnus, lamb. Each year on her feast two lambs are blessed in Rome, and their wool is woven into the pallium, the stole worn by archbishops. A young girl's faith is carried on the shoulders of the Church's shepherds.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, you always live to intercede for us. Hear the prayers we bring, and give us the courage of St Agnes. Amen.
share: He always lives to make intercession for them (Hebrews 7:25). How does it feel to know Jesus prays for me?
All who had diseases pressed upon him to touch him (Mark 3:10). What need draws me to Jesus?
Agnes was faithful though young. What can young people teach me about faith?
interc: For girls and young women, that they may be safe and respected.
For the sick who long to touch Jesus.
For archbishops who wear the pallium.
pm.close: Father, your Son always intercedes for us. Through the prayers of St Agnes make us pure, brave and faithful. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, Hebrews tells us something deeply comforting: Christ is able for all time to save those who approach God through him, since he always lives to make intercession for them (Hebrews 7:25). At this very moment the risen Jesus is praying for you.
He offered himself once for all, and now he is the mediator of a better covenant. We never pray alone; we pray inside his prayer.
In the Gospel crowds come from everywhere. All who had diseases pressed upon him to touch him (Mark 3:10). Even the unclean spirits cry: you are the Son of God! But Jesus silences them.

Today we honour St Agnes, a girl of twelve or thirteen who refused to deny her consecration to Christ and was martyred in Rome. She was weak in the world's eyes, but strong because Christ was praying for her. Let us trust his intercession and ask for her courage. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus is praying for you right now in heaven! St Agnes was a young girl who loved Jesus very much and was very brave.

intro: Theme: “He always lives to make intercession for them.”
Christ the interceding High Priest; crowds who touch him; Agnes strong in weakness.

q: Therefore I will allot him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he poured out himself to death, and was numbered with the transgressors; yet he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
Consequently he is able for all time to save those who approach God through him, since he always lives to make intercession for them.
points.apply: Pray today: Jesus, I join my prayer to yours.

sub: He heals by his word and touch.
q: he sent out his word and healed them, and delivered them from destruction.
for he had cured many, so that all who had diseases pressed upon him to touch him.
points.apply: Bring one sick person to Jesus in prayer daily.

q: My beloved is mine and I am his; he pastures his flock among the lilies.
But God chose what is foolish in the world to shame the wise; God chose what is weak in the world to shame the strong;
points.apply: Pray for the protection of girls and children.

concl: We never pray alone: Christ intercedes for us.
Like Agnes, the weak become strong in him.
